1.original_instruction: Approach any Continental Messenger and he will ask for your help. He can be found at any of the following locations: | Prontera (164, 304) | Geffen (128, 90) | Payon (200, 113) | Alberta (128, 64) | Al De Baran (136, 138)

1.short_en: Talk to any Continental Messenger in one of the listed towns.
1.full_ru: Подойдите к любому Continental Messenger и согласитесь помочь. Альтернативные места: Prontera (164, 304), Geffen (128, 90), Payon (200, 113), Alberta (128, 64), Al De Baran (136, 138). Источник помечает этот квест/событие как пока не реализованный; пометка должна быть снята после возвращения доступности. Примечание: на iRO Classic для доступа в Dimensional Gorge и боя с Satan Morocc требуется Dandelion's_Request, а не Continental Guard.
1.full_en: Approach any Continental Messenger and he will ask for your help. He can be found at any of the following locations: | Prontera (164, 304) | Geffen (128, 90) | Payon (200, 113) | Alberta (128, 64) | Al De Baran (136, 138) This quest or event is currently not implemented. If it becomes available again, this notice will be removed. Note: On iRO Classic to access Dimensional Gorge and fight Satan Morocc, the character must complete the Dandelion's_Request quest, not Continental Guard.

7.original_instruction: Once you defeat Satan Morroc , the Group of Evil will change. Each party member must click on it to receive Piece of Morocc Skin . Any player who was on the map can receive the skin regardless of whether or not they were in the party that killed Satan Morroc . | Satan Morroc will announce his defeat with "I'll let live just a little longer. You'll never find me through this time-space gap!"
7.short_ru: После поражения Satan Morroc лично нажмите Group of Evil и получите Piece of Morocc Skin.
7.short_en: After Satan Morroc is defeated, click Group of Evil yourself to receive Piece of Morocc Skin.
7.full_ru: После поражения Satan Morroc объект Group of Evil изменится. Каждый участник должен сам нажать на него, чтобы получить Piece of Morocc Skin. Кожу может получить любой игрок, находившийся на карте, даже если он не состоял в группе, убившей Satan Morroc. Реплика о поражении: «I'll let live just a little longer. You'll never find me through this time-space gap!».

8.original_instruction: The Piece of Morocc Skin can be given to Chief Balrog, in exchange for one of the following accessories of choice: | Seal of Continental Guard (+50 HP , +3% ASPD ) | Death Loop (+5 Crit ) | Rune Spellstone (+50 SP , -1% skill delay) The best strategy is to have one or two tanks for Satan Morroc , with Biochemists and others attcking him. Avoiding the mob is crucial to success, as by hitting them, their AI is activated, and they will then run loose and use their skills, which can easily wipe a party . Satan Morroc functions by using combos. At specific times he will make an announcement, which is the start of a skill combo. He always speaks when casting the first skill of the combo, and the combos are all the same order of skills cast. These combos are as follows: 80% HP - Magic Combo 60% HP - Hell Combo 50% HP - Vampire Combo 40% HP - Mixed Combo 30% HP - Earthquake Combo 10% HP 5% HP
8.short_ru: Отдайте Piece of Morocc Skin для Chief Balrog и выберите один аксессуар; получите 2,000,000 Base Experience.
8.short_en: Give Piece of Morocc Skin to Chief Balrog and choose one accessory; receive 2,000,000 Base Experience.
8.full_ru: Отдайте Piece of Morocc Skin для Chief Balrog и выберите один аксессуар: Seal of Continental Guard (+50 HP, +3% ASPD), Death Loop (+5 Crit) либо Rune Spellstone (+50 SP, -1% skill delay). Для боя с Satan Morroc источник советует одного-двух танков и атакующих, включая Biochemists. Не задевайте сопровождающих монстров: это активирует их AI и опасные умения. Satan Morroc объявляет начало комбинации перед первым умением; порядок умений в каждой комбинации фиксирован. Пороговые фазы: 80% HP — Magic Combo; 60% HP — Hell Combo; 50% HP — Vampire Combo; 40% HP — Mixed Combo; 30% HP — Earthquake Combo; 10% HP; 5% HP. 80% HP — Magic Combo. Перезарядка: 20 секунд. Реплика: "Impressive! I wonder how far your recklessness will take you." Умения по порядку: Stone Curse 10, Firebolt 10, Frost Diver 10, Jupitel Thunder 10. 60% HP — Hell Combo. Перезарядка: 35 секунд. Реплика: "I almost pity how outmatched you are against me." Умения по порядку: Area Sleep 5, Hell's Power 1, Hell's Judgement 5. 50% HP — Vampire Combo. Перезарядка: 50 секунд. Реплика: "It's time to finish the game!" Умения по порядку: Vampire's Gift 9, Area Soul Drain 10, Evil Land 10. 40% HP — Mixed Combo. Перезарядка: 1 минута. Реплика: "This is how you attack? Watch and learn, weaklings!" Умения по порядку: Pulse Strike 5, Area Stone Curse 5, Meteor Storm 5. 30% HP — Earthquake Combo. Перезарядка: 3 минуты. Реплика: "You worthless humans. Your so-called holy powers have no effect on me!" Умения по порядку: Area Hell's Power 1, Area Stun 5, Earthquake 10. 10% HP. Реплика: "Oh, you're stronger than I thought!" Умения: None. 5% HP. Реплика: "No, this can't be happening! I'm Satan Morroc, Demon King of Destruction!" Умение: Dragon Fear 10.
